input.descriptionHtml:
Personalised canvas prints made for your photos. Pick portrait, landscape, or square, choose slim or thick wrap, then select from 26 sizes and upload your image for a live product preview.

  • Gallery-quality canvas on FSC-certified stretcher bars
  • Slim (~2cm) and thick (~4cm) wrap
  • 104 size / orientation / thickness combinations
  • Printed and shipped on demand

seo.description: Personalised canvas prints — portrait, landscape, square, slim and thick wrap, 26 sizes.
seo.title: Canvas Prints | Pixora
